title: GRID - A Card Game on Nine Squares (update with Draft mode)
author: radiantforce
selftext:
[https://radiantforce.itch.io/grid](https://radiantforce.itch.io/grid)

Just released a major update to my strategy card game, GRID. It's a dream come true having played card games for more than a decade and now gaining the ability to develop with AI.

You've played Tic-Tac-Toe. Now, play it with cards.

Each counter can only be placed on specific board cells AND have abilities. I added a Draft mode too !!

Runs in the tab. No download.

comments.author: Bitter_Bunch2045
comments.body: How did you get the card art and card UI elements created? It looks really clean, especially with a pixel art style, currently struggling a little bit with my own card game in pixel art style

replies.author: radiantforce
replies.body: I used pixellab for card art. Claude for card UI.

comments.author: bingewavecinema
comments.body: Nice start. Feedback I have so far, building the deck felt confusing. There should be some UI element that tells how many more cards are needed or something.I had to use the auto build open.

replies.author: radiantforce
replies.body: thanks for giving it a try and for that feedback. It got lost somewhere as I was working through it. I have reinstated that now. it shows a X/30 counter now.

comments.author: SLAGDOCK
comments.body:
Looks good. Is it playable in browser?

  
We're building SLAGDOCK, a game portal website similar to the old MINICLIP, KONGRGATE, Newgrounds where people can find and play free to play browser based games. Like , favorite ,comment even create Clans. We would love to add your game! We just need the link and infos like : developer name, original release date and any Controls/Instructions to include

comments.author: Busy-Tower-1549
comments.body: Wow, someone that actually makes a game they want to make and not one prompt ai slop, keep it up man looks nice!

replies.author: radiantforce
replies.body: I can’t tell you how happy reading that felt after many hours at it, generating each sprite/background individually, ensuring card interactions work as it should. Thank you for the kind words.

replies.author: Busy-Tower-1549
replies.body: Im battling myself trying to make a game about my dog over last month, i went from 2d to 2.5d to 3d to text, and i cant even make anything close to as playable as yours :)

replies.author: radiantforce
replies.body: If it helps, VS code integrated with Claude Code is what did wonders for me.

replies.author: Busy-Tower-1549
replies.body:
I actually found Codex really good, but im thinking about cursor.   
I just have a lot of issues with animations, since i am trying to do 2d sprites in 3d world as weapons, sounds very simple but its painful to make the attack animations, horribly painful

comments.author: RoutineBell9578
comments.body: this looks really good! I like the concept of effecting certain tiles on the grid, almost like a mix of final fantasy tactics/ ff9 card game but different, its honestly unique. great idea, keep working on it! best of luck with it.

replies.author: radiantforce
replies.body: Thank you for the positive feedback. Yeah, cell restriction and balance was one of the hardest parts. I hope I got it right cause it’s what makes the game.
